newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest stocks end lower despite Policolor.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest stocks end lower despite Policolor.

text.p: Romanian blue chips ended lower on Wednesday, despite a sparkling performance by dye maker Policolor which outstripped the turnover level of each of the four high caps.
Two unofficial indices, the VAB and the BIG, inched down by 0.2 and 1.26 percent respectively from the previous session. The BIG first-tier index slipped by 1.95 percent to 3,162.83 points.
"Policolor performed extraordinarily today under a wave of buying and thanks to two special trades," a broker said.
Policolor gained 3 percent on its average price, which rose to 5,366 lei. But it closed flat at 5,300 under deals struck at the lower price in late trading.
The special Policolor deals involved 110,000 shares worth a total 583 million lei. The dye maker had 2.6 billion lei in turnover, or 26 percent of the session's overall turnover of 9.9 billion lei.

Operators said they expected the market to hover at the present level in coming days. They made no firm forecast for Thursday's session, but said investors would continue to buy Policolor and first-tier listings.
On the first-tier, chemical plant Oltchim closed 100 lei stronger at 2,600, while fertiliser maker Azomures lost 250 lei to end at 3,050.
Pharmaceuticals Antibiotice ATBE.BX and Terapia drifted down by 50 lei each and closed at 5,050 and 6,200 respectively, under nslight selling pressure.
